name: Egg Fried Rice with Brussels Sprouts, Mushrooms & Carrots
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. When the rice is done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place eggs in a large bowl. Whisk to combine.

Pour the egg mixture into the skillet. Scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the skillet. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny. Transfer to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice Brussels sprouts. Place in a clean large bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the Brussels sprouts along with the mushrooms and carrots.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned and tender, 4-6 minutes.
When the veggies are done, add scrambled egg, stir-fry sauce, and cooked rice to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide fried rice between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
